    Lemma 6.4 as stated #

    lem:split-positive-deformation (positive-deformations.tex): "S lifts to a unital subalgebra of B, and the filtration of B splits as S-bimodules. The resulting identification of B with Λ as filtered vector spaces induces the prescribed identification gr B = Λ, and the multiplication of B becomes μ₀ + Σ_{q>0} μ_q, where μ₀ is the multiplication of Λ and each μ_q raises internal degree by q, is S-relative, and vanishes when an input belongs to S."

    For S = Λ₀ with its vertex idempotents (Vertices): the splitting of exists_split is S-bilinear on both sides, so the transported product is S-relative (star_s_*) and each μ_q, q > 0, is a normalized S-relative cochain (μ_isRelS), and the statement is assembled in splitPositiveDeformation.

    def MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.IsRelS {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] (G : LenGrading k Λ) (μ : Λ →ₗ[k] Λ →ₗ[k] Λ) :
    Prop

    S-relative and normalized, for S = Λ₀: μ(sa, b) = sμ(a, b), μ(as, b) = μ(a, sb), μ(a, bs) = μ(a, b)s, and μ vanishes when an input belongs to S.

      theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.splitPositiveDeformation {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type u_3} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {P : PosFiltration G B} (V : G.Vertices) :
      ∃ (S : P.Split), (CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents fun (i : Fin V.n) => S.φ (V.e i)) ∧ (∀ (s a : Λ), G.IsHom 0 s → S.φ (s * a) = S.φ s * S.φ a) ∧ (∀ (s a : Λ), G.IsHom 0 s → S.φ (a * s) = S.φ a * S.φ s) ∧ (∀ (d : ℕ) (a : Λ), G.IsHom d a → (P.σ d) (S.φ a) = a) ∧ (∀ (d : ℕ), Submodule.map (↑S.φ) (G.geSub d) = P.F d) ∧ (∀ (a b : Λ), S.φ a * S.φ b = S.φ (∑ q ∈ Finset.range G.N, ((S.μ q) a) b)) ∧ (∀ (a b : Λ), ((S.μ 0) a) b = a * b) ∧ (∀ (q d e : ℕ) (a b : Λ), G.IsHom d a → G.IsHom e b → G.IsHom (d + e + q) (((S.μ q) a) b)) ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ), 0 < q → LenGrading.IsRel₂ V (S.μ q)

      Lemma 6.4 (lem:split-positive-deformation): a positive filtered deformation B of Λ splits: there is a filtered linear isomorphism φ : Λ ≅ B inducing the identification gr B = Λ, restricting on S = Λ₀ to a unital algebra map (the vertex idempotents go to a complete set of orthogonal idempotents) and S-bilinear on both sides; the transported multiplication is μ₀ + Σ_{q>0} μ_q with μ₀ the multiplication of Λ, each μ_q raising the degree by q, S-relative and vanishing when an input belongs to S.
